description: This file contains unit tests for the AsyncPipeline class, including performance, concurrency, and capacity behavior tests within the namespace UnitTests.AsyncPrimitivesTests.

classes.name: AsyncPipelineTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests validating the functionality, performance, and concurrency aspects of the AsyncPipeline class.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSimpleTest
methods.description: Tests the basic throughput and timing behavior of the AsyncPipeline.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineWaitTest
methods.description: Validates proper task execution and completion within the AsyncPipeline under load.

methods.name: TimedCompletions
methods.description: Creates an array of Tasks that complete after cumulative delays, used for timing tests.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSingleThreadedBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Checks the consistency and correctness of the AsyncPipeline in a single-threaded scenario.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs an in-depth accuracy, timing, and capacity test of the AsyncPipeline with multiple worker tasks.

methods.name: CheckPipelineState
methods.description: Validates the current state of the pipeline's size against capacity constraints during testing.
